Receiver.//: The transmitter is the demo transmitter the application starts itself (Keycloak does not emit SCIM Events): Program.cs sets TransmitterIssuer to its address. For a real SCIM service provider, set TransmitterIssuer, the token and the delivery method here.

Stream.//: the application registers its own POLL stream on startup and asks for the SCIM Events it mirrors; the transmitter assigns the audience of the SETs

Demo.//: the demo SCIM service provider under /demo/scim; Autoplay plays the life of two users on startup
